supervisor_summary: Update 2026-10-30 after the Q3 print: the first standard model valued INTC at $82.23, the research target (12m) then, vs $96 in the base round and the $65.76 close on 2026-10-30 (upside +25%). The Q4 guide resets client (CCPG down more than 20% q/q, PC TAM -12% 2026 and ~-10% 2027) and adds the Fab 28 hit, while DCAI keeps growing. At the citation gate the P/E leg was put on one basis: the peers' Zacks consensus expenses SBC, so INTC's own multiple is 47.3x, the exit 40.7x, and model EPS and the SOTP carry SBC as a cost. No 14A customer is named yet and the foundry option stays at $115B. Since then (model update 2026-11-16, citation gate 2026-11-17, carry rebuild 2026-11-18, gate fix 2026-11-19, PC-forecast refresh 2026-11-19) the research target (12m) is $90.64: downside case (P10) $49.16, upside case $137.00 (the engine distribution's P90 is $147.65 after the width floor); thesis break $47.
